werk.w_factoren_hier_haalt_de_analist_zijn: This is where the analyst draws patterns from — it does not sound as a term in the reading, but it does steer what can be said.
werk.w_factoren_bij_elke_zeldzaamheid_staa: Each rarity comes with three kinds of text:

spreek.bord: A bodygraph begins with an empty board. On that board there is room for nine centers, thirty-six channels and sixty-four gates. Nothing is colored yet, because the chart only becomes your chart through the moment of your birth. We build it up layer by layer, in the same way the wooden model is built.
spreek.centra: There are nine centers. They are the energy centers of the body: head, ajna, throat, the G center, heart or ego, sacral, solar plexus, spleen and root. Everyone has all nine. The difference lies in the question of which ones are defined, and which are open.
spreek.gedefinieerd: A colored, defined center is fixed. There you work in a reliable way, every day in the same manner. A white, open center takes in what others radiate. There you are sensitive, there you learn, and there you can also pick up conditioning. Open does not mean weak: it is the place where your wisdom can grow.
spreek.kanalen: A channel connects two centers. It consists of two gates, one at each end. If both gates are activated, the channel is defined, and the two centers are colored along with it. Black stands for what you carry consciously, the personality. Red stands for what lives unconsciously in your body, the design.
spreek.poorten: There are sixty-four gates, the ends of the channels. Each gate belongs to one of the sixty-four hexagrams of the I Ching, and carries a theme of its own. They are activated by the planets: at the moment of your birth, and about eighty-eight days before it. That is how your pattern comes about.
spreek.definitie: Definition tells how your defined centers are connected to each other. If they are all linked together, you process from within as one whole. If they form more than one island, you need other people or certain moments to build the bridge. If you have no defined centers, you experience the world through others.
spreek.hangend: A hanging gate is a gate that is activated in you, while the other half of the channel is missing. So the channel is not complete, and the center behind it is not defined by it. Such a gate is an open longing: you meet the missing half in other people, and you are drawn to them.
spreek.variabelen: Beneath your type, your authority and your profile lies an even finer layer: your variables. They do not tell you who you are, but how your body nourishes itself, where it feels at home and how your mind takes in the world. They are four arrows, two on the side of your body and two on the side of your mind: determination, environment, perspective and motivation.
spreek.slot: This is your whole chart. You have seen how it is built up layer by layer: the board, the centers, the channels, the gates, and what that means for you. You do not have to remember everything. Feel free to come back to the steps that touched you, and listen more deeply where you are curious.
